text_changes.before: For every jev code on a page or activity, the extractor (C-001; the quote step) extracts the verbatim supporting text from the page. RC-D-002 row 15 replaces "after jev has coded": the quote step never sees the answer for the field it quotes, but may see that a gate is not `none`. The quote step runs for every activity, including items the applicability table skips; those copies are kept internally, and the item is published as "not asked". A01 and CX-61 get quotes relevant to the field. The scale number is copied verbatim by the quote step and the classifier picks the unit; the publication date is coded by the quote step under the R-042 check. X35 adds an entailment check per (code, quote) with a chosen-answer probability bar.
text_changes.after: For every jev code on a page or activity, the extractor (C-001; the quote step) extracts the verbatim supporting text from the page. RC-D-002 row 15 replaces "after jev has coded"; RC-D-017 replaces its blind rule: the quote step sees the chosen answer for the field it quotes and copies the text that supports it, so it is a confirmatory step. It may also see that a gate is not `none`. Each supporting text (a quote, a link passage or a field's supporting text) is at most 200 characters; a longer one is kept whole and flagged. The quote step runs for every activity, including items the applicability table skips; those copies are kept internally, and the item is published as "not asked". A01 and CX-61 get quotes relevant to the field. The scale number is copied verbatim by the quote step and the classifier picks the unit; the publication date is coded by the quote step under the R-042 check. X35 adds an entailment check per (code, quote) with a chosen-answer probability bar.

text_changes.before: Supporting text is published with the code it supports. The API carries the full text; the website shows it up to a display cap, with a marker and access to the full text.
text_changes.after: Supporting text is published with the code it supports. The API carries the full text; the website shows it up to 200 characters, with a marker and access to the full text.
